```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Sample data for rendering

  dates = c("2026-09-08","2026-08-24","2026-04-16","2026-04-03")
data <- tibble(
  filenames = c("Temperature","Temperature_anomaly","Chlorophyll"),
  titles = c("Temperature","Temperature Anomaly","Chlorophyll")
)

```

## Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis



for (i in seq_along(data$filenames)) {
  
  cat(paste0("### ",data$titles[i],"\n\n"))
  
  for (j in seq_along(dates)) {
    
  cat(paste0("#### ",dates[j],"\n\n"))
  
   cat(paste0("![Start date: ",dates[j],"](","images/glider_transects/",dates[j],"/",data$filenames[i],".png){group='",data$filenames[i],"'}\n\n"))
  
  }

}


```
